map.电流斑（电流标记）特征: Features of the Current Mark (Electrical Mark)
map.：圆形或椭圆形，直径数毫米至1-2cm: : round or oval, from a few millimetres to 1 to 2 cm in diameter
map.：中央凹陷呈灰白色或黄褐色，周边隆起呈灰红色: : greyish-white or yellow-brown depression in the centre with a greyish-red raised rim
map.：坚硬，与周围组织分界清楚: : hard, with a clear boundary from surrounding tissue
map.：中央底部可露出真皮，无毛: : the dermis may be exposed at the base of the centre, without hair
map.：表皮细胞核拉长呈栅栏状排列（流水样排列），细胞极性化: : epidermal cell nuclei elongate into a picket-fence (stream-like) arrangement with cellular polarisation
map.：接触部位皮肤可检出导体金属元素（铜/铁/铝等）: : conductor metal elements (copper, iron, aluminium and so on) can be detected in the skin at the contact site
map.• 形态不规则，可呈线条状、星芒状: Shape is irregular and may be linear or star-shaped
map.• 高压电击可致大面积烧伤、炭化: High-voltage shock can cause extensive burns and charring
map.• 电弧烧伤可致皮肤衣物烧灼: Arc burns can scorch skin and clothing
map.• 潮湿皮肤接触电流斑可不典型或缺失: Contact with wet skin may produce atypical or absent current marks
map.电击死的法医学鉴定要点: Key Points for Forensic Assessment of Electrocution Death
map.• 确认电源来源、电压、电流类型: Identify the power source, voltage and current type
map.• 检查电路是否有漏电、短路、接地不良: Check the circuit for leakage, short circuit or poor grounding
map.• 注意现场是否为意外触电或他杀伪装: Note whether the scene indicates accidental shock or a staged homicide
map.• 检查死者衣物有无烧灼痕迹、金属导体残留: Examine the victim's clothing for scorching and metal conductor residue
map.：最关键的证据，多见于手部、足部等接触部位: : the most critical evidence, mostly seen on contact sites such as hands and feet
map.：电流斑处检出导体金属元素（SEM-EDX或原子吸收光谱）: : conductor metal elements detected at the current mark (SEM-EDX or atomic absorption spectrometry)
map.：高压电弧在皮肤上形成的树枝状/蜘蛛网状红色纹路: : dendritic or cobweb-like red lines formed on the skin by a high-voltage arc
map.：心肌断裂、血管内膜破坏、骨关节损伤（肌肉强烈收缩致骨折）: : myocardial rupture, vascular endothelial damage, bone and joint injury (fractures from forceful muscle contraction)
map.：电击致呼吸肌痉挛/中枢抑制可产生窒息征象: : electric shock can produce asphyxial findings through respiratory muscle spasm or central inhibition
map.：≥100mA可致心室纤颤死亡: : at or above 100mA can cause ventricular fibrillation and death
map.：高压(>1000V)损伤重，易致电弧烧伤；低压(220V)可致死但电流斑可能不: : high voltage (over 1000V) causes severe injury and arc burns; low voltage (220V) can be fatal but current marks may be inconspicuous
map.：经心脏（手→手、手→足）最危险: : passing through the heart (hand to hand, hand to foot) is most dangerous
map.：接触时间越长损伤越重: : the longer the contact, the more severe the injury
map.：潮湿皮肤电阻低，电流大但电流斑可能不明显；干燥皮肤电阻高但电流斑明显: : wet skin has low resistance so the current is large but current marks may be inconspicuous; dry skin has high resistance but obvious current marks
map.：交流电（尤其50-60Hz）比直流电更危险，易致心室纤颤: : alternating current (especially 50 to 60 Hz) is more dangerous than direct current and more likely to cause ventricular fibrillation

map.依电流斑形态识别：典型为灰白色/黄褐色、呈火山口状或裂隙状，表面有树枝状/珍珠状: Identify by current mark morphology: typical marks are greyish-white or yellow-brown, crater-shaped or fissure-shaped, with dendritic or pearly surface patterns (metallisation, vaporisation) and a hard consistency. Combine the entry (contact point), exit (opposite side) and current pathway (such as hand to trunk to foot) for analysis.
map.右手掌接触电源、电流斑 1 处（火山口状+树枝纹、表皮坏死），出口位于左足底（对: The right palm contacts the source with one current mark (crater-shaped with dendritic pattern, epidermal necrosis) and the exit at the sole of the left foot (a small symmetric patch), the pathway being right upper limb to trunk to left lower limb. This is consistent with single-phase AC contact with the current passing through the cardiac region, supporting death by electric shock.
map.没有电流斑就能排除电击吗？: Can electric shock be ruled out without a current mark?
map.不能。高压电弧、水中触电、接触时间短或湿性皮肤可无明显电流斑；应结合电气通路、金: No. High-voltage arcs, shock in water, short contact duration or wet skin may leave no obvious current mark. Combine the electrical pathway, metallisation deposits (SEM-EDX) and the on-site circuitry.
map.电流斑能区分交流和直流吗？: Can current marks distinguish AC from DC?
map.典型电流斑多见于交流；直流多为灰白凹陷伴电解烧伤，形态不具绝对特异性，需结合电压: Typical current marks are more common with AC; DC tends to produce greyish-white depressions with electrolytic burns. The morphology is not absolutely specific, so voltage, current type and histology must be combined.
